channel.title: OOglies
channel.desc: The OOglies slip, slide and splat all over the place. This fast-paced, madcap stop-motion animation uncovers the mischief everyday household objects get up to when no-one is looking. Fearless Pete Parsnip takes on some pasta bats and then star bar sets off on another trip to the moon. Mr and Mrs Strawberry get ready for a romantic night in front of the telly, the toast soldiers attempt to ambush an unsuspecting egg, and a pear and an apple amuse the judges with their strongman talent show act.
